mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% in a month indicates a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts by more than 5% over two months signals a strong demand in the housing market, which boosts related industries and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where HOUST increases by more than 5% over two months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals increased economic activity and supply-side efficiency, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it indicates strong job growth, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the months where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures rise by more than 1% in a month, it signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where RSAFS increases by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 5% and CPI is increasing by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals high inflationary pressure coupled with tight monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.2% in a month and nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 150,000, it signals a tightening labor market with strong job growth, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month and PAYEMS increases > 150,000
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2% and PAYEMS increases by more than 150,000.
